decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper with broad pretraining on 32M cell-text pairs and stated foundation-model use across multiple tasks. The described model relies on cross-modal alignment and contrastive learning, not an explicit generative architecture.
evidence_snippet: "cross-modal Cell-Language pre-training"; "CRA objective that incorporates sample reliability assessment, curriculum learning, and coupled momentum contrastive learning"; "pretraining on 32M cell-text pairs"
